_comment: Reviewed ASH findings that do not block CI. Every entry needs a reason. Keyed by (scanner, rule, file); line numbers intentionally ignored. See docs/SECURITY-BACKLOG.md for remediation timelines of accepted items.

allowlist.reason: False positive: shell variable named SECRET reads the existing CFN parameter at deploy time; no literal secret in source.
False positive: NoEcho parameter name / user-creation hint text; no literal secret in source.
Example script with fixed local URL; not part of the deployed service.
urlopen targets the configured LINEAGE_API endpoint only; scheme controlled by deployment env var.
HTTPS listener requires custom domain + ACM cert; tracked with transport-hardening backlog item.
TLS policy applies to HTTPS listeners; same backlog item as CKV_AWS_2.
Viewer TLS floor cannot be raised on the default CloudFront certificate; resolves with custom-domain work.
WAF deferred for POC (recurring cost); documented accepted risk, revisit at production promotion.
KMS on ECS log group: hardening backlog.
S3 versioning: static frontend assets are fully redeployed each release; low value.
